purpose: Map official Devin product areas and Devin University outcomes to curriculum coverage. Update this file when official docs, Devin University, or guides change.

status_definitions.covered: A learner can complete the outcome from current guides, with verification and sources.
status_definitions.partial: Some material exists, but a learner cannot complete the full outcome without missing steps or external improvisation.
status_definitions.watch: The product behavior is changing or undocumented; track before investing in a stable guide.

areas.area: Cloud-agent mental model and the Plan-Act-Verify loop
areas.notes: Core concepts exist. Keep examples aligned with Devin University terminology.

areas.area: Understand a repository with DeepWiki and Ask Devin, then review the PR with Devin Review
areas.notes: The loop is explained, but there is no dedicated hands-on lab for DeepWiki, Ask Devin, and Devin Review.

areas.area: Scope and delegate a first task, then drive the resulting PR to merge
areas.notes: Prompting doctrine exists. The end-to-end first-task lab needs clearer expected evidence.

areas.area: Understand ACUs, session sizing, modes, parallelism, and Session Insights
areas.notes: Cost is mentioned, but there is no dedicated efficiency guide with XS-XL sizing and post-mortem practice.

areas.area: Write delegation-quality prompts with say-how, checkable success, and bounded autonomy
areas.notes: Core strength of the current curriculum.

areas.area: Create and operate a Bot that owns an outcome
areas.notes: Strong foundation. Keep the six mechanics synchronized with official docs.

areas.area: Use, share, and govern Bot templates
areas.notes: Mechanics are present, but template governance and public-link risk need a sharper operational checklist.

areas.area: Control who can use a Bot and what the Bot can access
areas.notes: Access is introduced, but there is no dedicated security review exercise for sharing a Bot safely.

areas.area: Provision Bot connections, MCP sign-ins, plugins, secrets, Slack, and iMessage
areas.notes: Needs a provisioning runbook with least-privilege examples.

areas.area: Create event-driven and scheduled automations
areas.notes: Core guide exists. Keep triggers and preflight behavior synchronized with official docs.

areas.area: Choose among rules, skills, plugins, prompts, and playbooks for reusable context
areas.notes: Coverage exists. Maintain a decision matrix because this area changes quickly.

areas.area: Build and operate live internal tools with Devin Apps
areas.notes: Guide exists. Needs periodic verification because Apps are a fast-moving product area.

areas.area: Use Devin Desktop and the Agent Command Center
areas.notes: Current guide exists. Changelog drift should trigger small updates.

areas.area: Use Devin CLI for local sessions and cloud handoff
areas.notes: Core CLI workflow exists.

areas.area: Use CLI subagents, sandboxing, hooks, MCP servers, editor integrations, and plugin packaging
areas.notes: Advanced product areas are mentioned but need deeper examples and verification.

areas.area: Programmatically create, steer, observe, and analyze Devin sessions through the API
areas.notes: No dedicated API guide. Important for operators who want repeatable fleet automation.

areas.area: Run a migration as many small verified pull requests
areas.notes: Named-deployment-backed guide exists.

areas.area: Build living evals from production traces
areas.notes: Advanced guide exists. Reproduction cost must stay explicit.

areas.area: Design a multi-Bot organization with ownership, grants, roll-up reporting, and cost controls
areas.notes: A differentiating strength of the curriculum.

areas.area: Roll out Devin across a team or enterprise with adoption patterns and operating controls
areas.notes: Case-backed guide exists.

areas.area: Provision users, configure environments, govern cost, manage secrets, and operate organization controls
areas.notes: Enterprise patterns exist, but there is no admin operations guide.

areas.area: Apply security guardrails, audit trails, network controls, secrets handling, and secure rollout patterns
areas.notes: Official role track is coming soon. Track docs and prepare a security operations guide when stable.

areas.area: Enable non-technical teammates to delegate, review, and collaborate with Devin safely
areas.notes: Current material assumes engineering context. Needs examples outside code review.

areas.area: Art-direct design and visual work through Devin
areas.notes: Useful role-expanding guide.

areas.area: Learn from named field reports, wins, failures, and published numbers
areas.notes: Should consume newly verified registry entries continuously.
